subject: a puffin with a warped optical-pattern chest
pose: head upright while the body twists in a small dance
art_direction: 海鹦胸前的黑白环纹随身体扭转产生错觉，橘喙和青底把精简角色拉回清晰中心。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a puffin character with a compact upright head and a body twisting gently as if in a small dance. Keep its orange beak and dark cap simple, while the chest contains thick alternating ivory and charcoal rings that warp with the body curve. The pattern should create a subtle optical pulse without hiding the bird silhouette or becoming a dizzying full-frame design. One small bright eye and a slightly lifted beak give it dry amusement. Use a solid muted teal background and flat graphic rendering. Keep the feet tucked close together and the wings low, so the entire figure fits the circular crop. No extra symbols, text, or background pattern.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
